title: Restriction respects derived limit projections and constant units
statement: For each scheme and coefficient datum in [def-weil-pbc-pulled-reduction-comparison-data], the fixed lambda of [lem-weil-pbc-ordered-exchange-coefficient-comparison] respects every specified derived-limit projection, using the fixed exact evaluation square. On a constant derived tower it sends the completed constant-limit unit to the constant-coefficient diagonal/derived-limit adjunction unit followed by derived limit of the fixed diagonal restriction square. The attached Lean statement specifies the equalities.

source.place: Tag 099N (lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case), proof of (5); the augmented strict-tower and evaluation normalization of the second paragraph of the current blueprint proof is made explicit.

proof.text: Normalize lambda on complexes by its universal-unit equation. Compose with the projection and exact evaluation factors. Naturality moves the tower factor; the derived projection-unit formula reduces to the ordinary projection; ordinaryLambda preserves it. Cancel the unit on K-injective representatives and transport by naturality.

The ordinaryLambda map is the adjunction mate of the identity restriction/constant square, by its coordinates. Universal right-derived normalization identifies lambda with the derived mate. The normalized completed constant-limit unit is the unit of the derived adjunction. The mate unit identity gives the constant-unit equation.

proof_origin.place: The strict-model and universal-limit-normalization portions of the original argument, separated by M1.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictionLimitNormalization (T : Scheme.{t}) :
    (∀ (Z : DerivedCategory (d.towers T)) (n : ℕ),
      (OrderedExchange.lambda d T).hom.app Z ≫
          (completedRlimProjection T (exchangeConstantRing T A) n).app
            ((tres d T).mapDerivedCategory.obj Z) ≫
          (evaluationRes d T n).hom.app Z =
        (res d T).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((completedRlimProjection T (d.completedRing T) n).app Z)) ∧
    (∀ L : reductionDerivedCategory T (d.completedRing T),
      (res d T).mapDerivedCategory.map ((completedConstantRlimUnit d T).app L) ≫
          (OrderedExchange.lambda d T).hom.app ((completedDerivedConstant d T).obj L) =
        (OrderedExchange.diagonalAdjunction (A := A) T).unit.app
            ((res d T).mapDerivedCategory.obj L) ≫
          (OrderedExchange.rlim (A := A) T).map ((diagonalRes d T).hom.app L))
